review_text: A Carwash/Cafe Resto in Toril The Space are huge making it much more comfortable and cozy the indoor/open space setup are quite good it's perfect for chill while you wait for your vehicle to be cleaned. their drinks are quite good highly recommend their cereal latte and cookies too. other are quite excellent too the pricing are fair considering the space and ambiance.
The food is delicious! The ambience is nice too✨

Nice place to chill while waiting for your car. The thing is, the carwash takes a long time to finish even though there are many cleaners. We waited for more than an hour for our unit to start. You need extra patience when you wash theirs.
